 {key:'paperColor',type:'color',label:L('sample.paperColor','手動の紙色 / Manual paper color'),default:'#DCC68F',visibleWhen:{key:'paperMode',equals:'manual'},suggestions:{analysisPath:'data.paperCandidates',maxItems:4}}
];
const descriptor={moduleApiVersion:1,executionApiVersion:1,requiresFeatures:['color-suggestions','visible-when','analysis-display'],kind:'filter',id:'sosboy-san.analysis-display-sample',name:'自動色表示API接続サンプル / Automatic Color Display Sample',version:'1.0.0',implementationRevision:'readonly-analysis-display1',author:'sosboy-san',description:'自動では解析色を参照表示、手動では保存した色を編集するパススルーサンプル。',supportedStages:['pre','post'],parameters,
